strings.off_no_crucible: Edge is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_edge: Edge is off: this server does not run Edge.
strings.step_aside_secondaries: Edge secondary attacks step aside for {0}; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_quickstep: Edge quickstep steps aside for {0}; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_slope: Edge slope assist steps aside for {0}; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_swimreequip: Edge swim re-equip steps aside for {0}; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_lastshield: Edge last shield steps aside for {0}; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.preset_barrage_description: Fires several projectiles in a spread.
strings.preset_volley_description: Lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point.
strings.preset_piercing_description: Shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit.
strings.preset_scatter_description: Splits into ricocheting projectiles on its first surface hit.
strings.preset_spiral_description: Fires projectiles in a turning spiral around the aim.
strings.preset_meteor_description: Calls projectiles down from above around the aimed point.
strings.preset_burst_description: Repeats the weapon's full shot several times in a row.
strings.preset_sticky_detonator_description: Throws charges that stick; block to detonate them.
strings.preset_overcharged_bomb_description: Spends extra bombs for a bigger, stronger blast.
strings.preset_sneak_ambush_description: Charges while sneaking; the next hit releases blinding smoke.
strings.preset_rift_trail_description: The swing leaves a trail that keeps cutting enemies.
strings.preset_cleaving_thrust_description: A long thrust that strikes every target along its path.
strings.preset_launch_slam_description: Launches the target upward; it lands with an area impact.
strings.preset_aftershock_description: The slam sends weakening shockwaves forward.
strings.preset_knockback_chain_description: A mighty kick; struck enemies knock into others.
strings.preset_boomerang_description: The axe flies out on a curve and returns to your hand.
strings.preset_impact_burst_description: The thrown axe bursts with force where it lands.
strings.preset_spear_rain_description: Extra spears fall on the target your throw hits.
strings.preset_spinning_sweep_description: Keeps spinning the polearm until you stop.
strings.preset_fracture_line_description: Opens a crack in the ground that keeps damaging.
strings.preset_harvest_sweep_description: Keeps sweeping the scythe, harvesting crops around you.
strings.preset_summon_empower_description: Your nearby summons move and attack faster for a while.
strings.preset_shield_convert_description: Turns remaining shields on you and allies into healing.
strings.preset_count_by_quality_description: Staff quality raises how many summons you can keep.
strings.preset_level_by_quality_description: Staff quality raises the level of your summons.
strings.page_health_max: Health percentage costs use maximum health.
strings.page_health_current: Health percentage costs use current health.
strings.page_health_experience: Blood Magic experience per health consumed: {0}
strings.page_summon_lifetime: Default summon lifetime at this skill: {0} s
strings.page_cooldown_reduction: {0}: cooldown reduced by {1}% at this level ({2}% per level).
strings.dodge_cancel_description: Dodge or press block during an attack to cancel it. Uses the game's controls and normal dodge cost.
strings.page_dodge_cancel: Dodge or press block to cancel an attack.
strings.keep_crossbow_loaded_description: A crossbow put away loaded stays loaded when you draw it again. Firing still empties it.
strings.step_aside_archery: Edge archery features step aside for {0}.
strings.arrow_recovery_chance_description: Percent chance that an arrow you shot can be picked up where it hit the ground or an object. Arrows that hit creatures, land in water or burn are lost. 0 turns it off.
strings.bow_zoom_description: The camera zooms in as you draw a bow and back out when you release.
strings.bow_zoom_factor_description: Magnification at full draw (1 means no zoom).
strings.draw_indicator_description: A small bar under the crosshair fills as you draw a bow and lights up at full draw.
strings.compendium_intro: Secondary attack cooldowns get shorter as your skill with the equipped weapon rises.
strings.compendium_quickstep_description: With a knife or a fist weapon, Dodge makes a quickstep. Press Dodge again during it to go into a regular dodge.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Whole product. Off: attacks, swimming and slopes behave as the game does.
strings.cfg_1_general__secondaries_enabled_help: Adds a secondary attack to weapons, chosen by the presets below. Off: weapons use only the game's attacks.
strings.cfg_1_general__quickstep_enabled_help: Quickstep dash for knives and Unarmed-skill weapons.
strings.cfg_1_general__slope_assist_enabled_help: Melee swings connect with creatures up or down a slope.
strings.cfg_1_general__equipment_enabled_help: Weapons back in hand after a swim and the last shield coming back with a one-handed weapon.
strings.cfg_1_general__dodge_cancel_help: Dodge or press block during an attack to cancel it. Uses the game's controls and normal dodge cost.
strings.cfg_1_general__dodge_cancel_only_before_: Dodge Cancel Only Before The Hit
Dodge Cancel works only until the attack lands its hit. Off: an attack can also be canceled during its follow-through. Host or server; default off; applies at once.
strings.cfg_1_general__dodge_cancel_extra_stamin: Stamina a Dodge Cancel costs on top of the dodge. Without enough stamina the attack is not canceled. 0 adds no cost. Host or server; applies at once.
strings.cfg_1_general__inscription_cooldown_bonu: Quickened and Swift Casting on a weapon (Inscribe inscriptions) shorten its secondary cooldowns, at most by half. Off: secondary cooldowns ignore inscriptions. Inscribe's Inscription Effects setting also turns this off. Host or server; default on; applies at once.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__one_handed_elemental_weapo: Secondary attack of one-handed elemental weapons. Barrage: fires several projectiles in a spread. Volley: lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point. Piercing: shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit. Scatter: splits into ricocheting projectiles on its first surface hit. Spiral: fires projectiles in a turning spiral around the aim. Sentinel: hovering projectiles hunt nearby enemies. Meteor: calls projectiles down from above around the aimed point. Burst: repeats the weapon's full shot several times in a row. Off: no Edge secondary; the weapon keeps its own secondary attack, if it has one.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__fireball_staff_preset_help: Secondary attack of fireball staves. Barrage: fires several projectiles in a spread. Volley: lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point. Piercing: shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit. Scatter: splits into ricocheting projectiles on its first surface hit. Spiral: fires projectiles in a turning spiral around the aim. Sentinel: hovering projectiles hunt nearby enemies. Meteor: calls projectiles down from above around the aimed point. Burst: repeats the weapon's full shot several times in a row. Off: no Edge secondary; the weapon keeps its own secondary attack, if it has one.

Volley: lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point. Piercing: shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit. strings.cfg_2_ranged__bow_preset_help: Secondary attack of bows. Barrage: fires several projectiles in a spread. Volley: lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point. Piercing: shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit. Scatter: splits into ricocheting projectiles on its first surface hit. Spiral: fires projectiles in a turning spiral around the aim. Sentinel: hovering projectiles hunt nearby enemies. Meteor: calls projectiles down from above around the aimed point. Burst: repeats the weapon's full shot several times in a row. Off: no Edge secondary; the weapon keeps its own secondary attack, if it has one.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__crossbow_preset_help: Secondary attack of crossbows. Barrage: fires several projectiles in a spread. Volley: lobs several projectiles that land around the aimed point. Piercing: shots pass through several targets, weaker after each hit. Scatter: splits into ricocheting projectiles on its first surface hit. Spiral: fires projectiles in a turning spiral around the aim. Sentinel: hovering projectiles hunt nearby enemies. Meteor: calls projectiles down from above around the aimed point. Burst: repeats the weapon's full shot several times in a row. Off: no Edge secondary; the weapon keeps its own secondary attack, if it has one.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__bomb_preset_help: Secondary attack of bombs. StickyDetonator: throws charges that stick; block to detonate them. OverchargedBomb: spends extra bombs for a bigger, stronger blast. Auto: Overcharged Bomb when the bomb has an area, else Sticky Detonator. Off: no Edge secondary; the bomb keeps its own secondary attack, if it has one.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__arrow_recovery_chance_help: Percent chance that an arrow you shot can be picked up where it hit the ground or an object. Arrows that hit creatures, land in water or burn are lost. 0 turns it off.
strings.cfg_2_ranged__arrows_to_crosshair_help: Your arrows, bolts, thrown weapons and staff shots leave toward the point under the crosshair instead of parallel to the camera, so near targets are hit where you aim. Only the launch direction changes; gravity, speed and spread stay the game's. Host or server; default off; applies at once. Your own value applies on servers without Edge.
strings.cfg_3_blood_magic__summon_quality_preset: Staff quality raises summon level or summon count.
strings.cfg_3_blood_magic__summon_lifetime_secon: Base summon lifetime in seconds; 0 turns lifetimes off.
strings.cfg_3_blood_magic__lifetime_multiplier_a: Lifetime multiplier at Blood Magic 100, scaled linearly from 1 at skill 0.
strings.cfg_3_blood_magic__health_cost_uses_max_: Blood Magic health costs are a share of maximum health.
strings.cfg_3_blood_magic__health_cost_skill_rai: Blood Magic experience per health point consumed.
strings.cfg_4_slope__mode_help: Off, Fixed (attack height and offset) or Adaptive (also follows the camera pitch on slopes and toward targets above or below).
strings.cfg_4_slope__attack_height_help: Height in meters the player's melee sweep starts from (the game uses 0.6).
strings.cfg_4_slope__attack_offset_help: Forward offset in meters of the player's melee sweep.
strings.cfg_4_slope__adaptive_slope_threshold_he: Adaptive: ground steeper than this many degrees lets swings follow the camera pitch.
strings.cfg_4_slope__adaptive_max_pitch_help: Adaptive: most degrees a swing may tilt up or down.
strings.cfg_5_equipment__swim_mode_help: AutoRestore: weapons hidden by swimming come back after leaving the water. KeepInHand: never hidden while swimming. Off: as the game does.
strings.cfg_5_equipment__restore_delay_help: Seconds out of the water before weapons come back (avoids flicker at the shoreline).
strings.cfg_5_equipment__auto_equip_last_shield_: Equipping a one-handed weapon with an empty left hand also equips the shield you used last.
strings.cfg_5_equipment__keep_crossbow_loaded_he: A crossbow put away loaded stays loaded when drawn again. Firing still empties it.
strings.cfg_5_equipment__return_thrown_weapons_h: A thrown weapon that is not used up, such as a spear or a secondary-attack throw, goes back into your inventory in the slot it left when it lands. If that slot is taken it uses a free slot; with no room it falls where it landed.
strings.cfg_6_interface__secondary_tooltips_help: Weapon tooltips name the secondary preset.
strings.cfg_6_interface__key_hints_help: Show secondary and detonate key hints.
strings.cfg_6_interface__bow_zoom_help: The camera zooms in as you draw a bow and back out when you release.
strings.cfg_6_interface__bow_zoom_factor_help: Magnification at full draw (1 means no zoom).
strings.cfg_6_interface__draw_indicator_help: A small bar under the crosshair fills as you draw a bow and lights up at full draw.
strings.cfg_7_cheats__no_secondary_cooldowns_hel: Cheat. Secondary attacks have no cooldown. Each hit still keeps its short built-in delay.
